array.string: logs_dir="$HOME/Library/Logs/remote-coder"; mkdir -p "$logs_dir"; for log in "$logs_dir/chatgpt-shared-codex.log" "$logs_dir/chatgpt-shared-codex.error.log"; do if [ -f "$log" ] && [ "$(stat -f %z "$log")" -gt 10485760 ]; then mv -f "$log" "$log.previous"; fi; done; exec "$HOME/localbin/remote-coder-gateway/remote-coder-codex-gateway" --env-file "$HOME/.remote-coder/codex-gateway.env" runtime desktop launch >>"$logs_dir/chatgpt-shared-codex.log" 2>>"$logs_dir/chatgpt-shared-codex.error.log"
